scope: Read-only structure, internal continuity and chart reconstruction; no official-source price verification, trading, network provider access or raw-data publication.

decision.supported_now: Observed intraday price, volume deltas, open interest, best bid/ask display and approximate candles from observed trade-price updates.
decision.not_established: Complete individual-trade replay, exact intraminute extrema, absolute calendar timestamps, normalized average-price lines, full historical coverage, adjusted continuous contracts or a delivered product chart.
decision.next_input: Contract/source units and session metadata; native minute and daily bars can later provide their own OHLC. The owner remains responsible for external source accuracy.

observations.count_scope: Row/file observations include aliases; explicitly named unique-contract counts deduplicate identical file contents.

reconstruction_experiment.assumption: Assign 20260109 explicitly from the delivery folder for this one-day experiment, retaining raw TradingDay and source row. This is not a verified exchange-calendar rule.
reconstruction_experiment.clock: Relative milliseconds after an explicit 18:00 evening anchor; no inferred UTC or civil ActionDay.
observed_checks: Each sample has ordered buckets and valid OHLC bounds.
Minute, five-minute and daily known-volume deltas agree with source counter differences.
A nonzero initial counter remains unallocated; unknown volume propagates to larger bars.
No-trade quotes do not fabricate trade candles; empty minutes are not filled.
Six contracts, two views and three interval selections rendered and updated hover text in local Chromium.
limitations: Snapshots can hide trades and extrema between updates.
Auction folding and session-close binning remain unspecified; these sample candle counts are not exchange bar counts.
A one-day sample establishes no multi-day historical completeness.
A late snapshot and a normal session break are not independently classified as data loss.
The preview is an ignored local inspection artifact, not the desktop product workflow.

integration_rules.rule: Use the actual InstrumentID and preserve source file digest, original date/time, row order and adapter version. Treat all 116 byte-identical aliases as mappings rather than additional contracts.

Normalize the observed mixed labels through explicit source/session metadata. Retain raw TradingDay. Use a trading calendar and ActionDay or an explicit calendar assignment for absolute timestamps; do not blindly subtract one calendar day.

Retain distinct snapshots with identical timestamps in source order. Timestamp-only deduplication would discard valid updates. Exact duplicates may be excluded from derived views while retaining source provenance.

Difference cumulative counters; never sum them. Keep a nonzero starting baseline separate until auction/session rules establish its allocation. Reject resets or missing counters rather than silently bridging them.

Do not plot raw AveragePrice or infer universal turnover units. Observed scale varies by product family, and turnover has material regressions. Obtain source-specific normalization and contract metadata before using these fields for VWAP or cash-flow calculations.
Zero bid/ask prices and zero AveragePrice represent unavailable values in this sample, not zero-priced trades. A zero-volume contract is not evidence of corruption or a complete trade history.

Prefer supplied native minute and daily OHLC for their own resolutions. Resample with explicit session anchors and trading-day grouping; label any snapshot-derived candles as observed-price approximations.
Preserve daily alias-to-contract mappings and an explicit rollover/adjustment policy. Byte-identical one-day aliases do not establish a historical continuous-contract construction method.
Use a bounded local import/adapter task before runtime integration. Keep source selection replaceable and demonstrate the actual chart workflow separately from this inspection.

metadata_still_needed: Contract multiplier, tick size and source-specific field units
Trading sessions, auctions, holidays and timezone/ActionDay semantics
Previous settlement or previous close for the corresponding chart baseline

verification_scope.automated_gate: futures-tick-inspection uses synthetic counterexamples; public CI does not download or validate owner data.
verification_scope.owner_data_evidence: Full local scans and reconstruction receipts below. Only aggregate findings and diagnostic code enter the public repository.
